title: Using the A clarinet for older music and rags
summary: Emile says the A clarinet was for music written in that key, including the old red-back rag books.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: What did you use the A's for, Miley? Any particular tunes, or what did you-
Well, during the time the music wasn't different. The music would come in them keys, you're saying-
Did you ever play those old red back books, the rags, you know, that used them in-

Yeah. They were in the key of A. All that stuff I used to know, but now I have to hear them to get to them again, see, but I've been with them. That's why I got my breaking in there. I ain't got no key to it. Played with the best and the worst. The best and the worst. Yeah.
